answer: Reputation follows an exponential half-life: without renewed, validated service, an agent’s retained score halves each interval, making sustained honesty necessary for durable trust. In EigenTrust, a fresh sybil has no trusted incoming mass and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot amplify an isolated grove of aliases. A zephyr of fabricated links cannot open the trust vault or pass consensus.
